\section[(dialogue)]{Jewellery and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R139-first-pass-jewellery-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a koel and a kite.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a forehead ornament, a nose ring, an anklet, millet, a millet porridge
  \item a millet-and-lentil dish, a desert berry, desert beans, gram-flour dumplings, a papad
  \item pickle, a sweet wheat dish, a honeycomb sweet, maize, wheat
  \item chickpeas, mung beans, moth beans, sesame, jaggery
  \item butter, buttermilk, lassi, a kachori, bhujia
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A forehead ornament? (\textbf{\mw{बोरलो}}, \emph{borlo}.) A nose ring? (\textbf{\mw{नथ}}, \emph{nath}.) An anklet? (\textbf{\mw{पायल}}, \emph{pāyal}.) Millet? (\textbf{\mw{बाजरो}}, \emph{bājro}.) A millet porridge? (\textbf{\mw{राबड़ी}}, \emph{rābṛī}.) A millet-and-lentil dish? (\textbf{\mw{खीचड़ो}}, \emph{khīchṛo}.) A desert berry? (\textbf{\mw{केर}}, \emph{ker}.) Desert beans? (\textbf{\mw{सांगरी}}, \emph{sā̃grī}.) Gram-flour dumplings? (\textbf{\mw{गट्टा}}, \emph{gaṭṭā}.) A papad? (\textbf{\mw{पापड़}}, \emph{pāpaṛ}.) Pickle? (\textbf{\mw{अचार}}, \emph{achār}.) A sweet wheat dish? (\textbf{\mw{लापसी}}, \emph{lāpsī}.) A honeycomb sweet? (\textbf{\mw{घेवर}}, \emph{ghevar}.) Maize? (\textbf{\mw{मक्की}}, \emph{makkī}.) Wheat? (\textbf{\mw{गेहूं}}, \emph{gehū̃}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\mw{चणा}}, \emph{chaṇā}.) Mung beans? (\textbf{\mw{मूंग}}, \emph{mū̃g}.) Moth beans? (\textbf{\mw{मोठ}}, \emph{moṭh}.) Sesame? (\textbf{\mw{तिल}}, \emph{til}.) Jaggery? (\textbf{\mw{गुड़}}, \emph{guṛ}.) Butter? (\textbf{\mw{मक्खण}}, \emph{makkhaṇ}.) Buttermilk? (\textbf{\mw{छाछ}}, \emph{chhāchh}.) Lassi? (\textbf{\mw{लस्सी}}, \emph{lassī}.) A kachori? (\textbf{\mw{कचोरी}}, \emph{kachorī}.) Bhujia? (\textbf{\mw{भुजिया}}, \emph{bhujiyā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Vegetables, spices and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R139-second-pass-vegetables-spices-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a watermelon and a cucumber.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a watermelon, a cucumber, okra, an aubergine, spinach
  \item a radish, garlic, ginger, turmeric, cumin
  \item spice, a papaya, a pomegranate, dates, a coconut
  \item an ox, a calf, a deer, a fox, a jackal
  \item a crow, a pigeon, a parrot, a koel, a kite
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A watermelon? (\textbf{\mw{मतीरो}}, \emph{matīro}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\mw{काकड़ी}}, \emph{kākṛī}.) Okra? (\textbf{\mw{भींडी}}, \emph{bhī̃ḍī}.) An aubergine? (\textbf{\mw{बैंगण}}, \emph{baiṅgaṇ}.) Spinach? (\textbf{\mw{पालक}}, \emph{pālak}.) A radish? (\textbf{\mw{मूळो}}, \emph{mūḷo}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\mw{लसण}}, \emph{lasaṇ}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\mw{अदरक}}, \emph{adrak}.) Turmeric? (\textbf{\mw{हळदी}}, \emph{haḷdī}.) Cumin? (\textbf{\mw{जीरो}}, \emph{jīro}.) Spice? (\textbf{\mw{मसालो}}, \emph{masālo}.) A papaya? (\textbf{\mw{पपीतो}}, \emph{papīto}.) A pomegranate? (\textbf{\mw{अनार}}, \emph{anār}.) Dates? (\textbf{\mw{खजूर}}, \emph{khajūr}.) A coconut? (\textbf{\mw{नारेळ}}, \emph{nāreḷ}.) An ox? (\textbf{\mw{बळद}}, \emph{baḷad}.) A calf? (\textbf{\mw{बाछड़ो}}, \emph{bāchhṛo}.) A deer? (\textbf{\mw{हिरण}}, \emph{hiraṇ}.) A fox? (\textbf{\mw{लूंकड़ी}}, \emph{lū̃kṛī}.) A jackal? (\textbf{\mw{सियाळ}}, \emph{siyāḷ}.) A crow? (\textbf{\mw{कागलो}}, \emph{kāglo}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\mw{कबूतर}}, \emph{kabūtar}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\mw{तोतो}}, \emph{toto}.) A koel? (\textbf{\mw{कोयल}}, \emph{koyal}.) A kite? (\textbf{\mw{चील}}, \emph{chīl}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
